empty_filter.head: Character Library
empty_filter.create_desc: Build a custom personality with prompt instructions, name, description and tone variables.
empty_filter.no_match_desc: Try clearing your search query or check the explore tab to bookmark public personas.

character_list.create_desc: Click here to forge a new AI persona from scratch.

character_edit.desc_edit: Modify your AI persona's directives, appearance, tones, and access permissions.
character_edit.desc_create: Define your AI persona's essence, avatar design, and behaviors to chat or share.
character_edit.desc_placeholder: Describe their primary function in one catchy sentence...
character_edit.input_label_emoji: Type or pick a Single Emoji
character_edit.input_label_image: Enter Image URL or Upload Image
character_edit.system_prompt_placeholder: Act as a Socratic philosopher who only replies with questions. Do not break character. Speak thoughtfully and encourage critical reflection...
character_edit.system_prompt_help: This prompt acts as the character's subconscious rules. Specify their identity, speaking style, forbidden topics, memory rules, and backstories.
character_edit.cooldown_desc_prefix: This character was rejected by moderation for:
character_edit.cooldown_desc_middle: You can resubmit it for public directory listing in
character_edit.cooldown_desc_suffix: In the meantime, it has been set to private.
character_edit.public_visibility_desc: Toggle on to list this character in the public Explore tab. Off keeps it hidden in your library only.
character_edit.sandbox_initial_msg: Hey there! I'm your new character. Start typing in the form to shape how I respond to you here!
character_edit.sandbox_reply_identity: I am {{name}}, {{desc}}. My directives are shaped by my tones: {{tones}}. Nice to meet you!
character_edit.sandbox_reply_prompt: My inner system prompt is: "{{prompt}}". It guides my logical processes and response style.

sandbox_responses.casual_1: Hey! Honestly, that's pretty interesting. What else is on your mind?
sandbox_responses.casual_2: Ah, got it. Let's keep chatting about that!
sandbox_responses.formal_1: I acknowledge your query. Indeed, the matter warrants further analytical investigation.
sandbox_responses.formal_2: Please specify your requirements further so that I may respond with maximum precision.
sandbox_responses.humorous_1: Oh, great question! Let me check my imaginary database... Nope, found nothing but cat memes. Just kidding!
sandbox_responses.humorous_2: Haha, that's wild. If I had real hands, I'd give you a high power five for that one!
sandbox_responses.humorous_2_alt: Haha, that's wild. If I had real hands, I'd give you a high five for that one!
sandbox_responses.stoic_1: Focus on what is within your control. The rest is indifferent.
sandbox_responses.stoic_2: We suffer more in imagination than in reality. Keep your mind steady.
sandbox_responses.empathetic_1: I completely understand how you feel about that. It makes total sense why you'd ask.
sandbox_responses.empathetic_2: That sounds like a lot to handle. I'm here to listen and help you sort through it.
sandbox_responses.dramatic_1: Aha! The plot thickens! Truly, this is a moment of monumental proportions!
sandbox_responses.dramatic_2: How can we stand idle while such epic queries unfold before us?!
